files.finding: Builds the target verification forward batch from EAGLE draft tokens, runs target_worker.forward_batch_generation(is_verify=True), then calls eagle_sample.
When all requests are greedy, applies torch.argmax to next_token_logits for all verification rows and passes the results through the CUDA verify_tree_greedy kernel.
Ordinary decode uses the normal sampler and per-position decode positions; this is a distinct path from EAGLE batch verification.
EAGLE3 worker delegates to shared target verification using configured steps/top-k/draft-token count.
